name: Dhakai Jamdani Saree
description: A handwoven Jamdani saree from the Dhaka weaving tradition, recognised by UNESCO as an intangible cultural heritage. Features fine floral motifs woven directly into soft cotton.

name: Rajshahi Silk Saree
description: A lightweight silk saree from the Rajshahi region, known for its smooth drape and rich natural sheen. Suitable for weddings and festive occasions.

name: Nakshi Kantha Throw
description: A traditional embroidered Nakshi Kantha throw, hand-stitched in layers of cotton with folk motifs. Works as a bed throw, sofa cover or wall hanging.

name: Handwoven Jute Tote Bag
description: A durable, eco-friendly tote bag made from natural jute fibre, the golden fibre of Bangladesh. Reinforced handles and a cotton lining for everyday use.

name: Mirzapore Best Leaf Tea 400g
description: A popular black leaf tea blended from Bangladeshi tea estates in Sylhet and Chattogram. Produces a strong, bright and aromatic cup.

name: Frooto Mango Fruit Drink 1L
description: A refreshing mango-flavoured fruit drink, best served chilled. A familiar summer favourite across Bangladesh.

name: Chilli Powder 200g
description: Finely ground red chilli powder for curries, bhuna and marinades. Adds colour and a strong, even heat to everyday Bengali cooking.

name: Turmeric Powder 200g
description: Pure ground turmeric (holud) with a deep golden colour. An essential spice for dal, fish and vegetable dishes.

name: Chinigura Aromatic Rice 1kg
description: Small-grain aromatic rice, traditionally used for polao, biryani and khichuri. Soft, fragrant and fluffy when cooked.

name: Soyabean Oil 5L
description: Refined soyabean oil for everyday frying and cooking. Light in flavour and suitable for a wide range of dishes.

name: Chanachur 350g
description: A crunchy, spicy snack mix of fried lentils, peanuts and gram flour noodles. Often enjoyed with muri or alongside tea.

name: Energy Plus Biscuit
description: A light, crispy tea biscuit and a household name in Bangladesh. A handy snack for school, work or travel.

name: Beauty Soap
description: A mild fragrant beauty soap for daily bathing, from a long-established Bangladeshi personal care brand.
